title: Large forward discretely self-similar solutions to the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations with rough data
summary: We construct forward discretely self-similar (DSS) solutions of two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations with arbitrarily large data in $L^2_{loc}(\mathbb{R}^2\setminus\{0\})$. For such rough initial data, we first establish a sharp linear estimate under the discrete scaling, which identifies the \(L^2\)-norm of the initial datum on a fundamental annulus with the Dirichlet energy of its caloric lift over one period in logarithmic time.
